summary: Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets, which include borrowings for investment purposes, in the common and preferred stocks of companies located in China. China includes its administrative and other districts, such as Hong Kong and Macau. The fund seeks to invest in companies capable of sustainable growth based on the fundamental characteristics of those companies.
